adds.rationale: Google's Dec-9 Willow chip announcement validated a hardware-level breakthrough in quantum error correction, and Rigetti's stock and deal flow reacted immediately, giving the quantum wave a second liquid pure-play alongside IONQ just as the profile's next-wave-#3 thesis calls for early entry.

news_evidence.summary: Alphabet's Google announced the Willow quantum chip, demonstrating a major error-correction breakthrough
Rigetti announced a partnership with Quantum Machines to use AI to automate quantum-computer calibration, the day after the Willow news

adds.rationale: D-Wave rallied on the same Willow-driven quantum-computing validation event and shored up its balance sheet with a large at-the-market raise in December, giving the watchlist a second differentiated quantum-hardware approach (annealing vs. gate-based) to complement IONQ and RGTI.

news_evidence.summary: D-Wave shares gained roughly 15% the day of Google's Willow chip announcement, part of the sector-wide quantum rally
D-Wave completed $175 million in gross proceeds from its at-the-market equity offering programs, ending Q4 2024 with over $160 million in cash

removes.rationale: The tactical trigger for tanker exposure (tightening oil-reserve or rerouting dynamics) was absent this quarter; Q3 2024 results showed sequential rate declines, sell-side downgraded peer tanker names to Hold, and 2025 is guided toward oversupply, so the thesis for holding FRO has weakened rather than strengthened.

news_evidence.summary: Frontline Q3 2024 TCE earnings fell to $292.2M from $357.7M in Q2 2024; management flagged muted global oil demand growth and an oversupplied tanker market expected in 2025
Stifel analyst downgraded tanker peers Ardmore Shipping, Scorpio Tankers and International Seaways from Buy to Hold as rates fell short of expectations

rationale_overall: The watchlist stays anchored on AI, rockets/spacecraft, defense, and nuclear/uranium exposure, all of which delivered clean confirming news this quarter (RKLB's record launch year and SDA satellite contract, ASTS's commercial build-out, LUNR's NASA CLPS win, OKLO/SMR/CCJ underpinned by the Alphabet-Kairos and Amazon-X-energy hyperscaler SMR deals, GD/LMT/ITA/AVAV riding the largest global military-spending jump since the Cold War) with no fundamental breaches, so those positions are kept. The one thematic gap was quantum, which had only IONQ despite being next-wave #3; Google's Dec-9 Willow chip breakthrough was a structural validation event, so RGTI and QBTS are added to diversify quantum-hardware approaches (gate-based and annealing) without breaching the 4-per-bucket cap. FRO is removed because the tactical trigger for tanker exposure did not materialize; Q3 2024 results and sell-side downgrades point to softening rates and 2025 oversupply. Net effect: watchlist grows from 21 to 22 tickers, still under the 24 cap.
